Yes. With [TAG-147](https://linear.app/taguniversal/issue/TAG-147/example-1213-parallel-bus) marked `Spec Only`, a successfully emitted and GHDL-valid shell should show:

```text
Spec Only  ok  ok  🟡 unexpected pass
```

It is currently `FAIL` because the generated VHDL is not syntactically valid. The first errors are:

```vhdl
select : in std_logic_vector(7 downto 0);
```

`select` is a reserved VHDL keyword.

The group handling is also still being emitted as literal placeholders:

```vhdl
{group} : out std_logic_vector(7 downto 0);
{group}_valid <= {group}(0);
```

Those are not valid VHDL identifiers. Likewise, `out` in the `fanin` shell is a reserved keyword.

So the shell emitter needs to:

* Flatten or name grouped places instead of emitting `{group}`.
* Sanitize/reserve-check VHDL identifiers such as `select` and `out`.
* Emit valid internal signals for grouped bundle/mutex boundaries.
* Then GHDL should accept the shell, and [TAG-147](https://linear.app/taguniversal/issue/TAG-147/example-1213-parallel-bus) will correctly become `unexpected pass`.

The verifier classification is already doing the right thing; `ghdl_ok` is false because the generated shell itself is invalid.
